name: socialspire
description: Five founders' documented methods. Install them one at a time.

plugins.name: jeff-bezos
plugins.description: Work backwards from the customer. The PR/FAQ, the one-way door sort decided at seventy percent, the weekend store walk, and the blind value audit.

plugins.name: henry-ford
plugins.description: Set the price first, then find the cost that fits it. The price-first cost teardown, the deletion pass, the service statement test, and the incumbent burden total.

plugins.name: steve-jobs
plugins.description: Subtract until the thing is comprehensible. The demo review, cut to the gems, the cold read, and the road-map pitch.

plugins.name: elon-musk
plugins.description: Make the requirements less dumb, then delete the part. The Algorithm, the Idiot Index, drilling to the limiting factor of the limiting factor, and getting to reality.

plugins.name: john-d-rockefeller
plugins.description: Know your unit cost to the decimal. The solder-drop cost audit, the daily sheet, the ranked operator ledger, and planning boldly while implementing carefully.
